note: Small private campground in the Nicolet National Forest on WI-70 east of Eagle River, with a stocked fishing pond and nature trails; Anvil Lake's national forest beach is about 5 minutes away. Some sites are sold by the season. A 23-ft rig fits the power-and-water sites. --Claude
